name: Acid house
blurb: One squelching bassline and a drum machine.

context.code: note("a1 a1 a2 a1 c2 a1 e2 g1").fast(2).s("sawtooth").lpf(400).ftype("ladder").lpq(10).lpenv(4).lpdecay(.15).gain(.7)

sounds.why: Loud, dry and on every beat. With so little else in the track, the kick and the acid line are the whole record.
A clap and an open hat straight off the drum machine, with a little swing so the sixteenths jack.

sounds.name: Rimshot and cowbell
sounds.why: The 808's small sounds, placed off the grid of the kick. They are what make a drum-machine loop funky.

ingredients.name: A rimshot pattern
ingredients.adds: A click that never lands on a kick.

ingredients.name: Cowbell
ingredients.adds: Three cowbells spread evenly over the bar.
ingredients.listenFor: A second rhythm that crosses the first.

sounds.name: Second 303
sounds.why: A second acid line an octave or two up that answers the first. It plays less, so each note counts.
A cheap sampled minor chord, hit off the beat. It is the only harmony in the track.

sounds.name: Tom fill
sounds.why: Four toms falling in pitch at the end of a phrase. On a record with no breakdown, this is how you mark a new section.

ingredients.name: Toms on the last beat
ingredients.adds: High, high, mid, low, in the last beat of the bar.

ingredients.name: Only every fourth bar
ingredients.adds: Silent for three bars, then the fill.
ingredients.listenFor: It now announces the next phrase.

ingredients.name: Room
ingredients.adds: Lets the toms ring into the next bar.

knobs.label: reverb
knobs.above: They wash over the next kick.
